title: No Language Barrier
style: world pop electronic, 114 BPM, global percussion blend, uplifting multicultural energy, male vocal NZ/AU accent warm, multilingual hook, accessible melody, chantable chorus, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — percussion build, world instruments]

[VERSE 1]
She speaks Tagalog — he speaks French
They both want the same thing on the bench
She wants to learn — he wants to teach
Language was the wall — MOSOKO — breach

[CHORUS]
No language barrier — not today
No language barrier — learn your way
No language barrier — every voice
No language barrier — every choice

[VERSE 2]
Manila morning — Buenos Aires night
Same lesson — different light
Arabic Wednesday — Mandarin Thursday
Every culture — every person — every way

[BRIDGE — multilingual chant]
Sin barreras — no barriers
Walang hadlang — no barriers
No barriers — no barriers
No language barrier

[FINAL CHORUS]
No language barrier — every person
No language barrier — every lesson
No language barrier — the world is ready
No language barrier — MOSOKO steady

[OUTRO]
Every voice.
Every language.
No barrier.
